item.title: Sean of the South: The hills are alive with the sound of muzak
item.description: Canned music. It’s everywhere. You cannot get away from it. It is always playing in public spaces. Grocery stores, hotel lobbies, airplanes, colonoscopy exam rooms.Piped-in music is playing in hospital delivery rooms, this very moment. As new babies draw in the first breath of life, they are hearing Ke$ha’s “Party at a Rich Dude’s House.” Which is the name of an actual song. item.title: Weekend Recap: Alabama baseball sweeps Saturday double-header, takes opening series from Washington State
item.description: Alabama baseball split the first two games of the series with Washington State but took the final game to win the series. After dropping the season opener on Friday night, Alabama bounced back, outscoring Washington State by a combined 19-2 to win both games of Saturday’s doubleheader. The opening series was set to end with a Sunday finale, but due to rain in the forecast on Sunday, the game was pushed up to Saturday.
